why:
An Edit whose CANDIDATE asserts no EditInfo at all must reach Review -- never auto-match. A data gap is not evidence of difference, so it must not resolve the row in either direction.

THE TRAP this pins: `_EDIT_INFO_FIELDS` (the presence test) and `_edit_key` (the comparison key) are DELIBERATELY asymmetric. parent_id, version languages and ApproximateLength are compared but do not count towards being 'described', because every record carries a length and counting it would make an EditInfo-less record look described. Unifying the two lists reads exactly like tidying up a duplication, and it converts the gate into a rubber stamp: two empty keys compare EQUAL and every pair auto-matches, with no symptom anywhere.

A wrong implementation passes every POSITIVE test, which is why this fixture is negative. Mutation-tested: adding parent_id, version_languages and length_minutes to the presence list fails this fixture and no other.

SCOPE: pins the absent-info branch only. It says nothing about whether a DIFFERING EditInfo rejects -- that is a separate lesson and needs its own fixture.

notes: editinfo: base object data accepts 10.5240/FEED-0001-0002-0003-0005-K but the candidate record asserts no EditInfo -- identity cannot be confirmed, held for review
